title: 长事件的细粒度流式分片导致解析停顿

history.evidence: Diff changes rescanning/draining the entire accumulated line to a persistent scan cursor. The production method is backported exactly; existing current structure remains.

problem_zh: 题库生成遇到很长的单条流式事件时，网络分片越细，客户端 CPU 消耗越明显，界面长时间停顿，弱设备上甚至中断。请优化解析路径，在固定大小事件被大量小分片送达时保持近线性处理；不要丢失 Unicode、事件元数据、结束标记或清空后的新数据。
test_scope: Complete production SSE buffer and UTF-8 decoder. Fixed 2 MB / 2 million chunk workload, 3 s runtime budget; release mode required. Anchor measured 0.06 s locally. Candidate status until Linux reference calibration succeeds.
